name: Y;N
source:
"I haven't killed anyone!“

Imagine you wake up in a strange world and find yourself sitting on a death-chair.
What would you do?

That's exactly the situation Yin found herself in. Desperately protesting against her execution, Yin wakes up in a prison cell and a male voice starts to talk to her. Introducing himself as Keith Amon McInnes, he tells Yin that the world around them is called the Void and that every person who ends up there deserves it. Yin denies that thesis and claims her innocence. All she wants is to wake up from this nightmare.

[From [url=http://mirrowdothack.com/yin.html]The Official Website[/url]]
translation:
“我没有杀过任何人！”

想象一下，你在陌生的世界醒来，发现自己正坐在处刑椅上。
你会怎么做？

这正是茵所面对的处境。她拼命抗议自己的处决，醒来时却已经身处牢房，一名男性开始与她交谈。他自称基思·阿蒙·麦金尼斯，告诉茵，他们周围的世界名为虚空，所有来到那里的人都是罪有应得。茵否认这一说法，坚持自己是无辜的。她唯一的愿望，就是从这场噩梦中醒来。

[译自[url=http://mirrowdothack.com/yin.html]官方网站[/url]]
